scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,storefront -c magenta,yellow "npm run backend:dev" "npm run storefront:dev"
scripts.build: turbo build && npm --prefix apps/storefront run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n backend,storefront "npm --prefix apps/backend run start" "npm --prefix apps/storefront run start"
scripts.admin:create: cd apps/backend && npx medusa user -e admin@jankidesign.com -p ChangeMe123!
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/backend && npx medusa db:migrate && npx medusa db:migrate:search
